frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 9's jtbl_80015A0C table-offset residual closes once the hand-transcribed jtbl_80015A0C array is deleted from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same change that lands func_800747D8's real switch as committed C, mirroring the already-executed func_8006B578/jtbl_80015988 precedent.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 emits a switch's ADDR_VEC into the .rodata of the TU containing the switch; with the hand array still present in text1a_b_mid_rodata.c, the sandbox's isolated single-function build sees a placement/offset conflict rather than the real target layout.
frontier.next_probe: At final-submission assembly time (not a src/text1b.c-only session): delete the jtbl_80015A0C array from text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same commit as func_800747D8's C body, then re-measure with sandbox --disable all --diff.

frontier.hypothesis: The selection_sound block's C-spelling space (hunks 17-19) is exhausted by hand-derivation (s1-s2), permuter search (s3), and now confirmed out of reach of the new spelling_enum.py tool (s4, tool-shape limitation) -- the next productive lever is RA/scheduler solver classification, not another hand-written C variant.
frontier.mechanism: combine.c's isolated-test-variable branchless fold (s2) plus s3's 21.8k-iteration permuter confirmation plus s4's demonstration that flat-statement enumeration cannot even represent this if/else-diamond's respelling space
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/ra_solver's inverse_compose.py classify on hunk 17 (target lbu v0 vs ours lbu a0) to determine whether the v0-vs-a0 seat is RA- or scheduler-owned before proposing any further hand-written C variant; alternatively extend spelling_enum.py to treat each if/else arm as its own flat sub-region (a tool-improvement task, out of this session's src/text1b.c-only scope).

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 17's register-seat residual may resolve automatically once hunk 9's table-placement issue is fixed and the switch's real ADDR_VEC is in place.
frontier.mechanism: unconfirmed -- register allocation for this load may shift once the surrounding switch dispatch is compiled from real C rather than scored against a stand-in hand array
frontier.next_probe: Re-run sandbox --disable all --diff on the candidate AFTER the text1a_b_mid_rodata.c migration lands, before spending another session on register-seat levers for hunk 17 in isolation.
